title: feat(runtime,cli): a hook body reads ctx.provenance, so a flow-vs-user guard ships as metadata
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DJpRLxH24N6TCGQQWmVvX3L)_

Fixes #25905

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

A sandboxed hook body now reads the declared `HookContext.provenance`, the same server-stamped write provenance an in-process handler reads. A guard that tells a flow data node's write from a user's own write (hotcrm#2285's account-approval guard) can ship as a metadata-only body instead of being bundled.

- **Runtime, `buildSandboxContext`** (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts`, hook face only): projects `provenance` member by member: `flowRunId`, `attributedUserId`, `performedByClientId`. Each member is copied only as a string. The whole key is absent when none survives, which is what the engine face carries on a plain REST write. The source is objectql's `buildProvenance()` output on the hook context, never the payload. The action face (`buildActionSandboxContext`) is untouched.
- **Runtime, `installCtx`** (`quickjs-runner.ts`): grafts `ctx.provenance` frozen and non-writable, the same way `ctx.dispatch` is grafted, so a body cannot drift its own copy. It is installed only when the host side carried one.
- **Runtime, `ScriptContext`** (`script-runner.ts`): the `provenance` member is typed and documented.
- **CLI, `extract-hook-body`**: the `ctx.provenance` forbidden pattern is removed. A handler reading it lowers, and `os lint` no longer reports `hook-body/bundled-fallback` for it.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx` gets a sandbox-surface row, a "Write provenance" section (members, absence semantics, a guard example, the two guarantees), and drops provenance from the forbidden list.
- **Changesets**: two patch entries. `@objectstack/runtime` declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `ScriptContext` (a barrel export) gains the optional `provenance?` member; `dist/index.d.ts` goes 338119 → 339467 bytes, its export list is byte-identical (184 names), and that member is the only declaration that changed. `@objectstack/cli` declares `Clause-②: no`: its three `dist/*.d.ts` are byte-identical.
- **No `packages/spec` change.** The key was already declared on `HookContextSchema`. This PR makes the sandbox honour it.

## Tests

- New `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-provenance-signal.integration.test.ts` runs on real ObjectQL, real SqlDriver (better-sqlite3), real QuickJS and `hookBodyRunnerFactory`. Under the same caller identity it checks three things:
  - the flow-shaped write (execution context carries `flowRunId`) reads `ctx.provenance.flowRunId === 'run_25905'`, with keys `['flowRunId']`, after the body tried to drift the member and replace the key;
  - the REST write reads `typeof ctx.provenance === 'undefined'`;
  - a REST write whose payload carries a field `provenance` holding a forged JSON value shows it on `ctx.input.provenance` only, while `ctx.provenance` stays absent.
- `packages/cli/test/lowered-body-face-enumeration.test.ts`: `provenance` leaves the absent set (it now reads 4 refusals and 1 exception). Both faces are pinned to the three declared members.
- `packages/cli/test/hook-body-parameter-rebind.test.ts`: the three `ctx.provenance` spellings move from "refused" to "lowers".
- `packages/cli/src/lint/hook-body-lowering.test.ts`: a guard on `ctx.provenance?.flowRunId` gets no lint issue, and the build lowers it (`bodyExtracted: 1`, no warnings).

### Ablations (two, both via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

1. **Negative (forgery) pin.** `buildSandboxContext` was mutated to fall back to `JSON.parse(engineCtx.input.provenance)`, i.e. a consumer reading the payload. The pin went red at `hook-provenance-signal.integration.test.ts:165` (`expected 'object' to be 'undefined'`). Anchor 1 to 0, blob `58df4905a51e` to `81882a7eb7e0`, restored to `58df4905a51e`.
2. **Freeze.** The graft's `Object.freeze(p)` / `writable: false` was mutated to a plain writable value. The test went red at `:139` (`expected 'replaced' to be 'run_25905'`). Blob `04f49a96f07d` to `7c20c0ada09a`, restored.

The test imports `./body-runner.js` and `./quickjs-runner.js` from `src`, so no dist rebuild was involved.

## Local verification (head `df1c7164`; `256f0583` adds changesets only)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run`: Test Files 449 passed (449), Tests 8015 passed, 19 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: 330 of 332 files passed on the first run. The two failures were `published-subpath-console.pin` and `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`, which threw "packages/cli is not built". After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` both passed (29 tests). The integration tier is declared to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide eslint): exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 98 families): 95 exit 0. `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity` first exited 3 (CLI dist absent) and exit 0 after the CLI build. `--ran` reconciliation: 98 derived, 98 run.
- NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite only, none reads a changed file):
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: unbuilt plugin dists;
  - `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`: client-react dist absent;
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: shallow clone, fixture commit unreachable.

  CI runs all three.

## Acceptance notes

- A body may still define `ctx.provenance` itself on a write that carries none (the key is absent there, as with `ctx.dispatch`). That only affects the body's own VM. Nothing is written back from it, and it cannot reach another hook or the engine.
- `attributedUserId` and `performedByClientId` are exposed alongside `flowRunId`. All three are declared, server-stamped attribution marks. `session.userId` is already on the body face.
- #25653 (seat 1) edits the action face of `body-runner.ts`. This PR touches only the hook face's `buildSandboxContext` plus a new helper below it. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
